newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan seeks to sell 5,000 tonnes basmati rice.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan seeks to sell 5,000 tonnes basmati rice.

text.p: The state-run Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan (RECP) on Thursday invited bids, to be submitted by May 26, for the sale and export of 5,000 tonnes of basmati Pak-7 rice containing seven percent broken.
An RECP official said bids could be submitted for two lots of 2,500 tonnes each.
Pakistan exported 1.571 million tonnes of rice worth $393 million in the first 10 months of fiscal 1996/97 (July-June) against 1.133 million tonnes worth $372 million in the year-ago period.
In April, rice exports fell to 180,094 tonnes worth $48 million from 372,828 tonnes worth $62 million in March and compared to 118,141 tonnes worth $38 million in April 1996.
